objection:
I found no gap that is not trivially fillable. The proof proves the statement as stated, with the same ranges, error terms and uniformity.

Part 1:
- (13) is an exact algebraic identity. I rederived it from (12), using ΣE² = ΣQ² − 2x(M + xH) + x²H.
- The diagonal error is 3√x·W ≤ 3(1+K)x^{3/2}, using Y ≤ x.
- The endpoint error is cK·xY^{1−1/d}. This follows from (3) with y^{d−1} ≤ (Y/A)^{1−1/d}.
- The mixed error follows from the exact bound (9): |M(x;q)| ≤ 3√x τ(q)/q. This uses P1's product formula for squarefree n, so the zero case never occurs, together with cA_q ≤ 1 and the uniform bound |N_a(x) − xD_a| ≤ 3√x. Summing f'(k)/f(k) ≪ 1/k over k ≤ y gives a log x, which is absorbed correctly into x^{ε/2}. The constants L and J_η depend only on f and ε. Every modulus satisfies f(k) ≤ Y ≤ x because f is increasing, and every product h·f(k) ≤ x, so C_x is used inside its defined range.

Part 2:
- BGPVW 1998 Lemma 2.2, (2.6) and (2.7) are quoted verbatim; I checked them against papers/bgpvw-1998.pdf.
- Υ_k sums over all residue classes a = 1..q, not only those coprime to q.
- The normalisation E_2 = E is derived correctly by letting t → ∞ with q fixed.
- With k = 2 the lemma gives U(x,Q) ≪_ε x^{1+ε}Q for 1 ≤ Q ≤ x. The hypotheses hold with Q = Z = f(z) ∈ [2, x].
- The weight bound f'(k) ≤ Bz^{d−1} ≤ BA^{−α}Z^{α} holds for k ≤ z.
- The moduli f(k) are distinct integers at most Z, so the sparse sum is dominated by the full sum.
- Multiplying these gives x^{1+ε}Z^{2−1/d}.

Citations: the cited source is from 1998, so it is allowed. I also spot-checked (9) numerically for x up to about 3000; the worst ratio to the bound was 0.018.
other_issues: Cosmetic: the lemma's statement covers 1 ≤ Q ≤ x, but its printed proof only treats 'Q < x' explicitly. The proof under review uses Q = Z, which may equal x. The quoted statement covers this case, and continuity in Q (or doubling Q) handles it trivially. This is not a gap in the proof under review.

Process disclosure, not mathematical: the proof's notes say a bibliographical web search returned post-2010 sources and that reading stopped once their dates were identified. Nothing from them is used in the argument, and the cited result is the 1998 lemma from the supplied corpus.
